info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Rideshare Rides Fares-v5-spec
info.description: The Rideshare Fare Retrieval API allows users to access fare information for rideshare services. This API provides essential resources that detail fare estimates based on various factors such as distance, time, and type of vehicle. Typical consumers include developers building applications for rideshare platforms, as well as businesses integrating fare data into their services. By leveraging this API, users can enhance their apps with accurate fare calculations and improve user experience.

get.summary: Retrieve the fare for a specific ride.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to obtain the fare estimate for a given ride based on the specified parameters such as ride type and pickup location. Utilize this information for budgeting and planning your trip.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the fare information for rides. Ensure to provide the necessary parameters to get an accurate fare estimate.
